Top 3 Health Insurance Plans After Zero GST in 2025 | Sanjay Kathuria

For the first time in India’s history, health insurance premiums are now GST-FREE. Yes, you heard that right — the government has completely removed 18% GST on health insurance from 22nd September 2025.

Earlier, a ₹50,000 health insurance premium meant paying an additional ₹9,000 in GST. Now, with 0% GST, you save this amount every single year. Over decades, this adds up to lakhs of rupees in savings — money that can now go directly into protecting your family’s health.

In this video, Sanjay Kathuria breaks down:
✅ What Zero GST on Health Insurance really means
✅ How much money you can save annually & in the long run
✅ Which plans are now giving the best value after GST removal
✅ The 3 most recommended health insurance policies right now
✅ How Ditto Insurance helps you choose the right plan (unbiased & FREE guidance)

This is more than a tax cut — it’s a revolution for India’s health sector. If you’ve been delaying health insurance, now there’s no excuse.
